rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something pure and not mixed with anything else.

example.english: This is unadulterated fruit juice, with no water mixed in.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 hai6 seon4 gwo2 zap1 mou5 gau1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for an utter or out-and-out description, especially in expressions such as “unadulterated truth.”

example.english: What I'm saying is the unadulterated truth.
example.traditional: 我講嘅係不折不扣嘅真相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 ge3 hai6 bat1 zit3 bat1 kau3 ge3 zan1 soeng3
